series: 启示录：耶稣带来的安慰与盼望
title: 耶稣的应许
speaker: Eric Geiger · cloned voice POC
summary: 片段：看似失败的十字架其实是耶稣得胜；犹大支派的狮子压倒仇敌的吼声。

cues.text: 看似失败的事，其实是耶稣在战胜我们的仇敌，因为他是那位胜过一切的。
cues.source: What looked to be like a loss was Jesus really conquering our enemy, because he’s the one who conquers over everything.

cues.text: 你有一个仇敌，是一头吼叫的狮子。
cues.source: You have an enemy who is a roaring lion.
Who's seeking to destroy you and devour you.

cues.text: 但下周我们讲到《启示录》第4章和第5章时，就会看到耶稣被称为犹大支派的狮子，
cues.source: But we're going to see next week when we get to Revelation chapter 4 and 5 that Jesus is called the Lion of the tribe of Judah,

cues.text: 而他的吼声压倒了撒但的吼声。
cues.source: and His roar overwhelms Satan's roar.

outline.title: 看似失败
outline.body: 耶稣正在战胜我们的仇敌，他胜过一切。

outline.title: 吼叫的仇敌
outline.body: 仇敌如吼叫的狮子，企图毁灭并吞吃人。

outline.title: 犹大支派的狮子
outline.body: 耶稣的吼声压倒撒但的吼声。
